verdict.rationale: Calendly Workflows automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts tied to meeting events. Routing forms apply fixed-answer and CRM-ownership rules to route invitees. Webhook subscriptions fire in real time on schedule, cancel and reschedule events, so custom actions are possible, but only with your own server code. Native rule-to-action automation is limited to communications and routing, with no general-purpose rule builder evidenced. Missing for 10: a general condition/action rule engine beyond emails, texts and routing; documentation of Workflow trigger conditions and filters; independent or hands-on corroboration.
